images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original painted background panorama for ORDRE DE CENDRE, a grounded military science-fiction 2D side-scrolling walker game. Make one complete extremely wide 3:1 landscape image, approximately 3072 by 1024 pixels. Fine painterly matte-painting detail, realistic materials, atmospheric perspective, restrained colors, worn lived-in industry. Flat horizontal skyline composition for a side-scrolling game, no tilted camera and no vanishing road aimed at the viewer. This is distant scenery behind the playable ground: no people, no creatures, no robots, no foreground vehicle, no player, no text, lettering, logos, UI or borders. Keep the lower quarter calm and low contrast so dark foreground silhouettes and the active road remain legible. All small structures are far away, no huge foreground objects. Clean full rectangular opaque image. Original setting, no identifiable franchise designs. World: NACRE. A vast tidal industrial estuary in rain-softened dawn, petroleum blue ocean, saline green, wet gray steel and repaired wooden structures. Broad low harbor complexes and inhabited distant quays on pilings are grounded in the water, continuous dikes link low islands, sparse tall cranes have coherent braces and cables, turquoise algae and a few warm tiny quay lamps. Sea haze layers soften the distant coastline. Upper half is quiet pale storm cloud sky; the horizon is low and uninterrupted. Lower quarter is calm seawater, not a close beach or playable walkway. Convey a functional coastal civilization and working flood defenses, not ruins, no dramatic explosions. Palette navy teal, muted sea green, gray mist with restrained amber lights.
